ModuleName: 6 - External Libraries: jQuery, Bootstrap, and Plotting Tools

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module's lecture topics covering external libraries and CDN integration, jQuery fundamentals, DOM manipulation, events, Bootstrap components, and plotting tools, used by instructors to organize content delivery and by learners to preview what concepts will be taught.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: A topic outline for Module 6 listing and briefly explaining the key subject areas covered—including what external libraries are, how to load them via CDNs, and how to work with jQuery, Bootstrap, and plotting tools—intended to give learners and instructors an overview of the module's scope before diving into the lessons.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to External Libraries and CDN Integration
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains what third-party libraries are, how to load them via CDN using script and link tags, and why CDN hosting is preferred over local files, giving learners the foundation to include any external library in a web project.

Artifacts.Name: jQuery Fundamentals and DOM Manipulation
Artifacts.Description: A reading covering jQuery's core concepts including its selector syntax, DOM traversal, element manipulation, and cross-browser compatibility, teaching learners how to read and modify page content with concise jQuery code.

Artifacts.Name: jQuery Events and Dynamic Interactivity
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how jQuery's event system works — attaching listeners for clicks, keystrokes, form submissions, and hover actions — so learners can make static HTML pages respond dynamically to user interactions.

Artifacts.Name: Bootstrap Layout and the Responsive Grid System
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains Bootstrap's 12-column responsive grid system, including container types, rows, column classes, and breakpoints, enabling learners to build page layouts that adapt cleanly across different screen sizes.

Artifacts.Name: Bootstrap UI Components and Styling
Artifacts.Description: A reading covering Bootstrap's pre-built UI components such as buttons, cards, navbars, modals, and utility classes, showing learners how to assemble polished, professional interfaces without writing extensive custom CSS.

Artifacts.Name: Data Visualization with Chart.js
Artifacts.Description: A reading introducing Chart.js, explaining how to configure and embed interactive bar, line, pie, and other chart types into a webpage using a canvas element, so learners can present data visually in their projects.

Artifacts.Name: Combining Libraries in a Complete Web Project
Artifacts.Description: A reading that walks through integrating Bootstrap, jQuery, and Chart.js together in a single cohesive web project, demonstrating how to structure HTML, coordinate library responsibilities, and avoid conflicts between tools.
